lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Huh? The transformation stopped.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Are you kidding me? At a time like this?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: It can't be helped. It's my first time, so I'm not used to it yet.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: But they're still alive.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Barely.
Behemoth looks around.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: They're on their last legs, but I'm perfectly fine.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: This transformation thing is pretty nice. It even heals you.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I don't see any downsides to it.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: No wonder the Offsprings snubbed their noses at us.
It seems Behemoth's transformation is an ability she has just awakened.
Talk about bad timing.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Levi, let's capture that man alive.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Sure. He still has plenty of research value.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Over my dead body!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Begone, you foul beast!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: No thanks, I'd rather stay.
*Snap*
Behemoth snaps her fingers.
*Thud thud thud thud*
Numerous Raptures rain down from the sky.
At the same time, more approach from behind her.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: There are so many of them!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Did you do that?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I certainly did.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You can summon Raptures? How?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I just felt like I'd be able to.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Maybe after transforming, they recognize me as a true Heretic?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Are amazing! Haha! Truly amazing!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Stop, you're making me blush.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Now then, let's have the Raptures take care of those annoying pests,

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: and we'll snag the treasure after.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: The treasure that will help us evolve.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Sounds like a plan.
The Raptures begin to focus their attack on Absolute.
In the meantime, Behemoth and Leviathan slowly walk towards me.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Anis, Neon. Let's go.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Things are really getting dangerous now.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yeah, but we still have to go.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah. We've gotta help Rapi win.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You said it!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Let's go!
The Counters charge forward.
They are hit and sent flying.
Grabbed and flung through the air.
Knocked to the ground by rocks tossed by one of the pincers.
Anis fights through the pain and stands up.
Neon rapidly stands back up, pretending to be fine.
Rapi stands up, never taking her steely gaze off the enemy for a moment.
Again, they are knocked down,
and again, they get back up.
Knocked down.
Back up.
Knocked down.
Back up.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Why don't you just run?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I won't chase you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What?! Do you hear what you're saying?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Come back later.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We'll talk then.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Go ahead. I won't chase after you. Promise.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Is this a joke to you?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Don't screw around with us!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Rapi finally opened up to us, and getting her to talk is like drawing blood from a stone.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We promised her that we'd help.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We finally feel like we're a part of something.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We're not giving up before we've even properly started.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: The outcome may be uncertain, but I do know one thing:

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: If we lose here, if we run, if we give up,

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: we won't be able to move forward.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Not Rapi, nor us.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: So we have to win.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You guys...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Stop talking and start attacking.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Come at us, you big oaf!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Ahhhhhhhh!
Rapi charges forward,
with Anis and Neon close behind.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Behemoth.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Why don't we hire them?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Make them part of the team.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: That's a good idea. I told you they were good.
Black liquid rises around the Counters mid-charge.
It quickly envelops them and forms a sphere.
No!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We must get them to come to our side, whatever it takes.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: They're too good to pass up.
I start running towards Behemoth and Leviathan.
I bite down on my hand.
After drawing some blood, I sprint towards the black sphere.
My vision instantly darkens.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What's this?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: He entered the Black Sea?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Did he go in to save them?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It would appear so.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Does he intend to use the Vapaus to neutralize the Black Sea?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Apparently.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Has he lost his mind?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I would say so.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ugh, what a headache this is turning into.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'll go in and be right back.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Are you going to do some of that hypnosis of yours?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's called Mind Control, thank you very much.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: The Black Sea is compatible with NIMPH, so creating illusions is no big deal.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Although it does tire me out.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Be careful. Last time you did that, you vomited all over the place.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You were bedridden for three days afterwards.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's thanks to that that we were able to make these spheres in the first place.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Furthermore, you've been working hard enough.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's time I do my part.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I have to evolve too, don't you think?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hehe, you're right. Trust me, you've been more than pulling your weight.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Go ahead. I'll keep the others from interfering.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Okay. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That girl whose hair turned red. Her name's Rapi, right?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You remember her name? You must have taken a liking to her.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hmph.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'll break her first. She seems to be the glue holding everyone together. If I take her down, they should all topple soon enough.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Don't go too hard on her. Otherwise, there won't be much left of her to join the team.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Okay okay. I'll do my best.
Leviathan enters the black sphere.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What a strange feeling.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I can't explain it, but I feel like we're not the only ones about to evolve.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: This is odd.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: There's nothing here.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Normally, there will be a space of some kind containing memories, painful or joyous.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ah, that's right. You don't have a NIMPH, do you?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Interesting.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: A little bosom buddy.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You're telling me you're my friend?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I've come to hear your troubles. What's ailing you?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I wanted to become Red Hood.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: But... It didn't work out.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That's unfortunate.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: But Grave told me that

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: there's more to it than simply accepting responsibility.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: First, you assume the mantle, and then you go your own way.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You carry the legacy of your predecessor on your shoulders, and you'll never forget them, but you also forge your own path.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: That's what I'm trying to do.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Anis, Neon, and the Commander said they would help.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I think I can do it.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: No. You have already failed.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: All you're doing is running away. How is that doing that legacy justice?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: If you ask me, I think it's an excuse.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: When things don't go as planned, you fool yourself and say, "Oh no, actually, this was what I intended to do all along."

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Haha. It's laughable.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: All you're doing is sugar-coating the fact that you failed. Shamelessly attempting to justify your shortcomings.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Really?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yes, really. So just give up.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You've failed.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You've been a failure your entire life.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Wouldn't it be better to simply remain here and pass on?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: There's no way I failed.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You have.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I haven't shown anyone the real me yet.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'm not Red Hood. I can never be her. Because I'm not her.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I haven't even started down my own path yet. How could I have failed?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: The Commander said so himself.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: He said he was looking forward to seeing what I'd become.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I have to show him.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I can't let him down.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: As long as the Commander is with me, as long as Anis and Neon are with me, I can keep going.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: As long as I keep moving forward,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I will be able to fully be myself, and I'll have done Red Hood's legacy proud.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You're stronger mentally than I thought you'd be.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Fine, this isn't working. It'll be a bit tough, but I'll just break your mind.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Wh-what?!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Who are you?!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Why are you here?! How can you be here?!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Gaaaaaah!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: How is this possible?!
Leviathan sinks below the sea.
Rapi stares at the red Nikke standing before her.
In this liminal space between dreams and reality, Rapi feels her eyes well up with tears.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I... I never thought I'd see you again.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: This is really going to be the last time, isn't it?
Red Hood nods her head gently and smiles.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I've misunderstood the meaning of what you passed on to me.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Now I know.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: My friends showed me the way.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: In my heart... I really wanted to become you.
Red Hood gazes warmly at Rapi.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I had nothing.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I was nothing.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I didn't know who I was.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: But the Commander...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Neon.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Emma.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Vesti.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: They all showed me who I am.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Now I know.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Even if I may not have a clear picture of who I am,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I can still justify my own existence through other people.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Rapi! Rapi!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Rapi! Where are you?!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'm still not entirely sure who I am,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: but as long as I walk shoulder-to-shoulder with them,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: with people who I care about,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I think I can find out.
Red Hood extends her hand.
Rapi hesitates, and then extended her own.
She knows that this is their final farewell.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Please, watch over me.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: With all that you've given me,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'll lead a life full of meaning,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: and eventually, I will be complete.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Any chance you could whip a weapon up for me?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Something super neato.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: ... Sure. Is there anything you have in mind?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: A drill.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: A drill.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Why a drill?

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Cause it's cool.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: ... Fine.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: So about the gun... can you do it?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: Sure thing.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: I can make it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_o
lines.text: It might take some time, but I can do it.

lines.speaker: redhood
lines.text: Awesome. Don't forget, you promised!
*Craaaaaack*!
Behemoth's pincers shatter into pieces.
Rapi doesn't stop and keeps charging.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Haha! So you've evolved as well!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Aaaaah!
*Craaaaaack*!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Whoa... hold on...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Ugh... Aaaaah!
*Craaaaack*!
Rapi punches straight through Behemoth.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Am... azing...!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Behemoth!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Levi... run!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She's... too strong!
*Boooooom*!
Behemoth explodes in a burst of black liquid.
Leviathan desperately clutches for her core,
then dives back into the black pool.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Just you wait!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I-I'll get you for this!
Leviathan rapidly disappears into the black pool.
Rapi, breathing heavily, looks at the spot where Leviathan disappeared.
She then closes her eyes,
and proudly proclaims:

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... We won!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Rapi, you...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Completely transformed! And just when we were at our lowest moment! Actually, it's all a bit cliché...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What... what is this...?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: How did this happen?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Incredible...
You've done Red Hood proud.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm much better now.
Good.
Let's find Cinderella and Grave and head back.
Victory is ours.
